[[File:Julian-Faylona avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Julian-Faylona.]]
'''Julian-Faylona''' is an artist whose image is used on three [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Julian-Faylona @ DeviantArt". The credit points to DeviantArt, an online art community. The credited cards are [[Insidious Prisoner|•Insidious Prisoner]], [[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon]], and [[Scarif: Command Center|•Scarif: Command Center]], in [[Virtual Set 11]] and [[Virtual Set 16]] (released 2019–2021).
